title: c00lkidd Idle Laugh
blurb: Somewhere off-screen a giggling Roblox killer is having a wonderful time, and you have no idea how far away he is. c00lkidd began life as a legendary Roblox exploiter account and has since been rebuilt as a playable killer in Forsaken, where the idle laugh functions as a mechanic rather than a flourish. You hear it. You cannot locate it, and you immediately start making bad decisions. Horror design has been running that con since long before Roblox existed, and here it is again, with a red-and-green cartoon child doing the honours.
origin: c00lkidd's idle laugh from the Roblox game Forsaken.
